children: Halima, Mariya and Fatima Dangote discussed the next generation of leadership at Dangote Group on Bloomberg Next Africa, according to Bloomberg.

They said the family plans to expand cement production, invest in refining, fertilizer and power, and build a family office aimed at preserving the family’s legacy. They also discussed creating more value from Africa’s resources at home, the role of partnerships and investment, and plans for a pan-African IPO of the Dangote refinery.

title: Dangote Daughters Outline Growth Plans for Family Empire
